current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference_limitations: Linear interpolation is a matched conventional anchor, not DISK or state-of-the-art pose estimator.
Our animal-disjoint six-landmark short-gap slice differs from original DISK long/multiple gaps.
DANNCE/s-DANNCE video outputs cannot silently replace measured mocap truth.
Only two heldout animals; units unverified.
recommended_next_comparator: Retrain DISK Transformer and GRU on animals 1–3 only, same six landmarks, 31 frames and fixed seven-frame HeadF gap; test animals 4–5 unchanged. Add multivariate Kalman/spline/rigid-head references; report training budget separately.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
limitations: Linear interpolation is a matched conventional anchor, not DISK or state-of-the-art pose estimator.
Our animal-disjoint six-landmark short-gap slice differs from original DISK long/multiple gaps.
DANNCE/s-DANNCE video outputs cannot silently replace measured mocap truth.
Only two heldout animals; units unverified.
negative_findings: No leaderboard for our six-marker seven-frame animal-heldout gap verified.
No current video-pose model establishes best coordinate-only imputation on this contract.
